title: Worker termination reason is not the same as semantic task outcome
summary: The live OBS-02 worker created the only permitted artifact with the required PASS marker, yet the wrapper reported worker_failed because max_steps_reached occurred after the useful edit.
claims: The worker report recorded changed_files containing only the permitted artifact.
decision: PL-03 verifier must evaluate acceptance evidence independently of worker termination reason, then choose done, one bounded repair, or compact escalation.
rationale: Transport/step-budget termination can occur after acceptance evidence has already been produced; treating termination alone as semantic failure creates false negatives.

evidence.note: Contains both acceptance artifact evidence and worker_failed/max_steps_reached outcome.
